india.one_line: Indian AI developments span new model launches under the IndiaAI Mission, infrastructure investments, startup funding, and policy discussions.

themes.title: Chariot AI launches models under IndiaAI Mission
themes.text: Chariot AI launched the Chariot-1 model suite under the IndiaAI Mission, featuring an 11-billion-parameter language model and a text-to-speech system supporting 10 Indian languages.

stories.headline: Chariot AI unveils Chariot-1 LLM and speech models under IndiaAI Mission

themes.title: Bharti Airtel invests in Assam data centres
themes.text: Bharti Airtel signed an MoU with the Assam government to invest ₹1,200 crore in three data centres with a combined capacity of 40 MW by 2028.

stories.headline: Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres

themes.title: Startup funding and workforce shifts in India
themes.text: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M raised $9 million in funding, while Swiggy Instamart laid off 340 employees amid an AI push.

stories.headline: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M raises $9 Mn
Swiggy Instamart lays off 340 employees amid AI push and inventory shift

themes.title: Policy and legal developments around AI
themes.text: The Delhi High Court is examining if AI can be a copyright author, and Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman discussed AI in a pre-budget meeting with Gen Z representatives.

stories.headline: Delhi High Court to examine if AI can be author under copyright law
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman holds first Gen Z pre-budget meeting
